notes.title: Updated the Official version 1.0.3 and the demo version 0.2.7.
notes.content:
We have updated the official version v1.0.3 and the demo version v0.2.7. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45258684/88ec2071fb9c25a8b4073134aa22007a557d3422.png"]

Implemented usability improvements.

◆Main changes
- To make organizing MEMO easier:

Increased the maximum number of saved MEMO from 40 to 60.

Added a filter to narrow MEMO by speaker.

These updates should make the later, more challenging chapters easier to play.

- Improved controller usability:



Doubled right-stick scroll speed while the LOG window is open.

Added a brief input lockout on choice prompts to prevent accidental selections when rapidly advancing dialogue.

- Added in-game quick hints:


After a Game Over in each chapter, you can choose to view a quick hint to help identify whether someone is a Yokai or a Human.

If you're still stuck, feel free to reach out on the Official Discord server!
https://discord.gg/AEhsP6FFJW 



 - Other minor improvements and bug fixes.



We hope to continue growing "Yokai Landlord: Monster Mystery!" with care and passion. Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: Updated the Official version 1.0.2 and the demo version 0.2.6.
notes.content:
We have updated the official version v1.0.2 and the demo version v0.2.6.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45258684/5a4e8f20298c5dba8f5d657299d2828805b60a24.png
Brushed up some scenarios and adjusted translations.

◆Main changes
- Based on player feedback—“Why doesn’t the landlord simply ask the tenants ‘Are you a yokai?’”—we have added a new dialogue choice in Chapter 1 that allows you to directly pose this question.

This adjustment is intended to help players more fully experience the emotional and relational complexities that underpin the story.

Rather than focusing on whether there is a “correct” answer,
we hope this addition conveys the emotional and logical weight of choosing to confront someone.

- Added new lines to Chapters 4 and 5 to further explore Yokai impersonation and its implications.

- We have adjusted several lines in the English translation where overly liberal translations made it difficult to convey the subtle nuances of the original Japanese script and affected the difficulty of constructing “suspicious” as a form of evidence.
(Select lines in Simplified Chinese have also been adjusted accordingly.)


Whether you're playing for the first time or returning to see what's new,
we hope you'll follow the story through to its end.
If you enjoy the experience, we'd greatly appreciate it if you could leave a Steam review.

◆Gathering strategy information, spoiler feedback, and bug reports.
We look forward to hearing from you on the official Discord server!
https://discord.gg/AEhsP6FFJW


We will continue to be a "Yokai Landlord: Monster Mystery!". Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: Updated the Official version 1.0.1 and the demo version 0.2.5.
notes.content:
We have updated the official version v1.0.1 and the demo version v0.2.5.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45258684/7a79f08758f837100f8f4ad81068c0fd8dd61556.png
The following improvements, bug fixes and translation defects have been corrected.

◆Main changes
- For “remarks where the memo button trembles” during conversations with residents, the “LOG” screen has been modified so that it also trembles on the “LOG” screen side.
- Modified to be able to select “Don't show again” for the confirmation dialog when deleting a memo in the memo screen.
- Adjusted the timing of the decision to unlock the achievement “Check all Activity Log”.
- Fixed bug in Chapter 5 where the English and Simplified Chinese names of “suspicious” were partially blank.
- Fixed a typo in each language and a color tag flaw for a resident.
- Fixed a translation error in English and Simplified Chinese.


Since its official release, many people have been playing the game, and we are very grateful to everyone who has played it.

It is difficult to respond to all of your comments, as we want to deliver the intended experience in some areas, but we have made usability adjustments.

We hope that you will continue to play the game until the end, and if you like, we would appreciate it if you could help us by writing a review on Steam.

◆Gathering strategy information, spoiler feedback, and bug reports.
We look forward to hearing from you on the official Discord server!
https://discord.gg/AEhsP6FFJW


We will be giving out hints and exchanging various opinions when you get stuck on a strategy.
Please feel free to join us!


We will continue to be a "Yokai Landlord: Monster Mystery!". Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: Official release on April 25th(JST)!
notes.content:
"Yokai Landlord: Monster Mystery!" will be officially released on Friday, April 25 (JST)! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45258684/3290b5cee3ec4c31a462c9dcdd388d6d1fdd5848.png

💡 Contents to be added in the full version
- Five chapters plus an epilogue 
Mystery hidden in the apartment - and the identity of the "Mysterious Man"?
The end of the story will finally be revealed.

🎧 Original soundtrack also available on the same day 
10% off during Release Period (April 25-May 6) to mark the launch

🉐 Complete bundle of game + soundtrack (16% off) 
Will be available only during Release Period (April 25-May 6).
Combined with 10% off the soundtrack alone, it is an even better deal!

📢 Changes to Video Distribution Guidelines
We were expanded the scope of our video distribution guidelines on Tuesday, April 15, prior to the release of the full version of the game.
The story up to the end of Chapter 3, which has been very well received, will be available for video distribution.


To all Early Access players and distributors, we hope you will continue to enjoy the game until the full version is released, and if you would like to help us out, please fill out a Steam review.

💬 We also welcome your comments, suggestions, and bug reports on our Official Discord Server!
https://discord.gg/AEhsP6FFJW


We will continue to be a "Yokai Landlord: Monster Mystery!". Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: Updated the Early Access version v0.6.1 and the demo version v0.2.2.
notes.content:
We have updated the Early Access version v0.6.1 and the demo version v0.2.2.
The following bug fixes, minor functional improvements, and translation flaws have been corrected.


Fixed a bug in which notes could not be taken when “LOG” was displayed on the “Examine” screen after checking the surveillance camera image with “Camera” after Chapter Two.
Fixed a bug that caused a freeze at extremely low frequency when the writing process was interrupted by a cancel operation while a memo was being recorded.
The mouse cursor is now hidden when using the keyboard or controller, so that operations do not interfere with each other.
In the tutorial, the mysterious man now mentions that the note button shakes when someone says something important during a conversation, and that the contents of a conversation can be checked in the “LOG” menu even after a week has passed.
Adjusted resolution settings and window settings to be fixed when operating SteamDeck, and changed the Discord button on the title screen to be hidden.
Fixed some speaker icons on the “LOG” screen.
The position of line breaks in the “LOG” screen was unnatural when the language setting is English.
When the language setting is Simplified Chinese, an error in the color specification of character names in some sections has been corrected.
Fixed other minor bugs and translations.

We will continue to further debug, brush up, and develop the final chapter to the full version, while reflecting your opinions and bug reports.
Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: Early Access version now available!!
notes.content:
We have started distributing the Early Access version of the game on Tuesday, March 25! (v0.6.0)
For $8.99 USD, almost half the price of the full version, you can enjoy the third chapter out of five chapters.
(Estimated playing time is about 6 hours)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45258684/d5d24980d39ea118a68ebc96c3c109fdac530014.jpg

In addition, we have updated the demo version of the game, which can be played for free up to the first chapter.
Various bug fixes and usability improvements have been implemented, and we hope that those who have not yet played the game, as well as those who have played the game and are considering purchasing it, will take the time to check it out.

 v0.2.0 → v0.2.1
Added help images in Tutorial and Options.
Added the Activity Log screen.
Some additions and adjustments were made to the Chapter One scenario.
Added LOG button to the Examine screen.
Adjusted the cursor focus on the various screens.
Changed the assignment of the back key on the Manage Info screen and the Eviction screen.
Adjusted the read SKIP function.
Fixed other minor bugs and translations.

This correction has also been applied to the Early Access version.
Please note that save data cannot be transferred between the demo version and the Early Access version.


We have created a song focusing on the sub-theme of this work, “a quietly heartwarming story of characters growing up”.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45258684/853f8a84fdb657ddf1872011db919c228e471d62.png
The vocalist is Inori, who is active on the YouTube channel “Inori, Song, Travel and ☁".
She sings the message of this work in her clear voice that purifies the souls of those who listen to it.
A short version is also available in the Early Access version.


We have also opened an Official Discord Server.
https://discord.gg/AEhsP6FFJW

Please feel free to join us to exchange information, chapter strategies, opinions, and bug reports.


Please run through Compatibility - Proton.


We are planning to improve this issue in future updates.
When closing the notepad while writing a note, the game may freeze with extremely low frequency. When this occurs, please exit the game from the Steam console or from the Task Manager.


We will continue to be a "Yokai Landlord: Monster Mystery!". Thank you for your continued support.
